readMe: The pre-decided resolution record the backlog rows execute. Keyed repo -> path -> { clusters, take, why, source, notes, stage, row }. stage is pre-align (own commit on the branch before the merge), merge (inside the one 'Merge origin/main' commit; conflict = git marks it, clean-but-wrong = git merges it silently and it is wrong), wire-in (own commit after the merge) or follow-up (own commit, found by verification). source says whether the take comes from the survey (extract) or from its verification (verify); where a verification corrected the survey, the correction is applied here. Conflict lists come from measure.json (trial merges ins d664c0e9, animals affadd1d, plants 171c002c, tests d4ac0a82). Lockfiles are never hand-merged: after the merge the main session regenerates them (ins, animals, plants under pinned npm 11.6.2 via the repo's npm-version script, e.g. npx --yes "$(node scripts/npm-version.js)" install then a clean install; tests with plain npm). Agents cannot install.
